copias.menuAyuda: A copy of the work on an SD card or USB stick, in case the phone is lost or broken
copias.para: If the phone is lost or broken, the work is on the card. Servos keeps a copy a few minutes after each change, and with «Receive» it all comes back on another device with Servos.
copias.conContrasenaQue: Whoever finds the card cannot read the copy or tell what it is. If you forget the password, the copy is useless: no one can open it, not even Servos.
copias.sinContrasenaQue: Anyone who has the card can open the copy and see what it is. For teams who do not mind others seeing their work.
copias.corta: At least {n} letters or numbers: a short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
copias.noIguales: It is not the same as the one above.
copias.anotela: Write it down somewhere safe, away from the phone and the card. It is not kept anywhere and cannot be recovered.
copias.noProtegeTelefono: The password protects the copy, not the phone: whoever has the phone unlocked can open Servos.
copias.faltaTarjeta: The copy could not be kept: the card is not in. It is kept by itself when it is back.
